ACADEMY WITHOUT A CODE (changed)
Menu > Academy. There is no 3-digit code any more: the screen shows the belt you
are wearing and the belt your next course earns, and Start just goes. Start is
grey when the next course has not been written yet — only the first one has, so
that is expected once you are past white. The website link is still there,
because that is where the video lives; you pick the course there by belt colour
rather than by copying a number back.

ACADEMY ON A SMALL SCREEN (fixed)
Worth a look on the smallest phone you have. The Close and Start buttons were
being pushed off the bottom edge and were unreachable. They should now be fully
visible with room to spare, with both belts still drawn at full width.

ACCOUNT DETAILS (new)
Menu > You are Logged in. Shows the email and name you are signed in as, and the
belts you have earned in a grid. Log out has moved here from the menu. The email
and name are plain text, not boxes — they are not editable, and should not look
like they are.

DELETE ACCOUNT (new)
Account Details > DELETE ACCOUNT. Asks for your password before anything is
destroyed, so a mistyped one costs nothing — get it wrong deliberately and you
should stay signed in exactly as you were. Getting it right removes the account
and returns you to the menu signed out. Your submitted samples are not deleted;
the server reassigns them to its anonymous user.

BELTS
Get every creature right in an Academy session to earn a belt: a ribbon across
the top-right corner of the Menu screen. It saves to your account — sign in,
earn one, reinstall, and it should come back. If it does not, that is worth
reporting.

WHICH QUESTION DID I GET WRONG
After an Academy assessment, tap a cross and then the which-question prompt. It
should land on the couplet where those two creatures actually part, on the path
you walked — not somewhere you never went.

TRAY BUTTON
Deep in the key, the ice cube button takes you back to the tray you came from,
training or survey. It is absent if you entered the key from the menu.

SYNC FEEDBACK
Sync on the samples list: progress bar and a Show Logs pane. Try it with the
network off — it should queue and retry rather than fail.
